claude_proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.modify_range for named ongoing aura geometry
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing top-level shape fits `class_feature` with `mechanics.family = "passive"`, but the surface cannot honestly express a passive feature that modifies the emanation radius of another named feature already in play. This is best modeled as a surface variant on the existing v4 `modify_range` atom, not a new family.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Your Aura of Protection is now a 30-foot Emanation.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: cross-feature target reference on passive effects
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Aura Expansion does not grant a new aura; it mutates Aura of Protection. The surface needs a way to point at the existing feature or attachment being modified so the authored data can say which aura becomes 30 feet instead of duplicating Aura of Protection as a second independent effect.
